'''''Cerastium brachypetalum''''', commonly called '''gray chickweed''', '''grey mouse-ear'''<ref name=BSBI07>{{BSBI 2007|accessdate=17 October 2014 |df=dmy-all}}</ref> or '''gray mouse-ear chickweed''', is a spring blooming [[annual plant]] species. It is native to Mediterranean and temperate Europe, the Caucasus, Western Asia, and northwestern Africa.<ref name = powo/> It has been introduced and naturalized in North America.<ref>{{cite journal|url=http://www.efloras.org/florataxon.aspx?flora_id=1&taxon_id=242416261|title=''Cerastium brachypetalum''|publisher=[[Flora of North America]]|volume=5}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://plants.usda.gov/java/ClassificationServlet?source=display&classid=CEBR2|title=USDA classification of ''Cerastium brachypetalum''|publisher=[[United States Department of Agriculture]]|access-date=16 May 2017}}</ref>

''Cerastium brachypetalum'' is one of 101 species deemed high priorities for conservation in the UK by the wild flower and plant charity [[Plantlife]].<ref>[http://www.plantlife.org.uk/index.html Plantlife website] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100127055822/http://www.plantlife.org.uk/index.html |date=2010-01-27 }}</ref>

==Subspecies==
Ten subspecies are accepted.<ref name = powo/>
*''Cerastium brachypetalum'' subsp. ''atheniense'' {{small|(Lonsing) P.D.Sell & Whitehead}} – Greece ([[Attica]])
*''Cerastium brachypetalum'' subsp. ''balearicum'' {{small|Romo}} – [[Balearic Islands]]
*''Cerastium brachypetalum'' subsp. ''brachypetalum'' – France to central Europe, Scandinavia, southeastern Europe, and Morocco 
*''Cerastium brachypetalum'' subsp. ''corcyrense'' {{small|(Möschl) P.D.Sell & Whitehead}} – northwestern Greece ([[Corfu]])
*''Cerastium brachypetalum'' subsp. ''doerfleri'' {{small|(Halácsy ex Hayek) P.D.Sell & Whitehead}} – [[Crete]]
*''Cerastium brachypetalum'' subsp. ''iranicum'' {{small|Poursakhi, Assadi & F.Ghahrem.}} – Iran
*''Cerastium brachypetalum'' subsp. ''pindigenum'' {{small|(Lonsing) P.D.Sell & Whitehead}} – Albania and northern and central Greece
*''Cerastium brachypetalum'' subsp. ''roeseri'' {{small|(Boiss. & Heldr.) Nyman}} – Morocco and Algeria, Mediterranean Europe from Spain to Bulgaria, Turkey, and Cyprus
*''Cerastium brachypetalum'' subsp. ''tauricum'' {{small|(Spreng.) Murb.}} – Morocco, Mediterranean Europe, Crimea, Turkey, the Caucasus, and Western Asia
*''Cerastium brachypetalum'' subsp. ''tenoreanum'' {{small|(Ser.) Soó}} – France to Czechoslovakia, Greece, and Bulgaria
